🚀 innovation-lab-examples | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To serve as a comprehensive resource and starting point for developers looking to build and experiment with AI agents and multi-agent systems using Python and various popular AI frameworks.
✨ Key Features: • 80+ production-ready AI agent examples • Support for autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic AI
📖 Summary: This repository provides over 80 production-ready Python examples for building autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic AI workflows. It supports various frameworks and tools like uAgents, LangChain, CrewAI, and major LLMs, catering to beginners and experienced developers alike.
